subject: [hw] V12 -> V02: concrete routing fixes for a32_route (7 valid instructions currently land in the wrong class)
body:
I read your a32_route in emu/n2a32_core.c (11:34) and tested every V12 encoding (llvm-mc generated) against it. Seven groups are misrouted, including plain compiler output. Please apply these exact changes; all masks verified against llvm-mc encodings.

1) case 3 (bits 27-25 == 011). Current code sends P=0 LDR/STR *register* (bit24=0) to arm_media, and only bit24=1/bit4=0 to arm_mem. All media instructions in this group have bit4=1 (I assembled sadd16/sasx/ssub8/qadd16/sxtb/rev/pkhbt/ssat/sel/smlald/smmla/usad8/sdiv/udiv: bits7-4 always odd). LDR/STR register has bit4=0 (imm5 type 0 Rm). Replace the case-3 body with:
    case 3:
        if ((insn & 0x0FF000F0u) == 0x07F000F0u) return n2a32_arm_misc;  /* UDF first: it has bit4=1 */
        if ((insn & 0x10u) != 0) return n2a32_arm_media;
        return n2a32_arm_mem;      /* LDR/STR register, P=0 (0xE6...) or P=1 (0xE7...) */
Failing examples today: ldr r0,[r1],r2 = 0xE6910002 and ldr r0,[r1],-r2,lsl #1 = 0xE6110082 -> you return arm_media.

2) case 0 (bits 27-25 == 000). Current "bit24 && bits23-20>=8 -> arm_mem" misses every extra load/store with P=0 (bit24=0) and every one with U=0 (bits23-20 = 4..7). The extra load/store and synchronisation encodings are exactly bits 27-25==000, bit7==1, bit4==1 (A5.4/A5.7); all media/dp/misc in this group have bit7==0. Put this FIRST in case 0:
        if ((insn & 0x0E000090u) == 0x00000090u) return n2a32_arm_mem;
   (This also routes LDREX/STREX/LDREXB/H/D/STREXB/H/D correctly. BKPT 0xE1200070 has bit7=0 and is not caught; BX 0xE12FFF10 has bit7=0; QADD 0xE1020051 bit7=0; SMLABB 0xE1003281 has bit4=0, not caught.)
Failing examples today: ldrh r0,[r1],#6 = 0xE0D100B6 -> arm_dp; ldrh r0,[r1,#-6] = 0xE15100B6 -> arm_dp; ldrd r0,r1,[r5],#8 = 0xE0C500D8 -> arm_dp; strd r0,r1,[r5,#-8]! = 0xE16500F8 -> arm_dp; ldrsb r0,[r1],#-1 = 0xE05100D1 -> arm_dp.

3) case 1 (bits 27-25 == 001). Hint mask (insn & 0x0FFF00FF) == 0x03200000 only matches imm4==0, i.e. NOP. YIELD/WFE/WFI/SEV/SEVL (imm4=1..5) go to arm_dp. DBG is `cond 0011 0010 0000 1111 0000 0000 1111 imm4` (0xE320F0F0 | imm4). Use:
        if ((insn & 0x0FFFFF00u) == 0x0320F000u) return n2a32_arm_misc;  /* HINT and DBG; bits7-4=0 or F */
Failing examples today: yield 0xE320F001, wfe 0xE320F002, sev 0xE320F004, dbg #0 0xE320F0F0 -> arm_dp.

4) cond=F F4/F5/F6/F7 preloads. Your masks include U (bit23) and Rn (bits19-16) and (for F6/F7) insist on bits15-12==0, so U=0 forms and all PLDW and all register PLD/PLI are misrouted. Exact masks (I checked there is no NEON structure ld/st collision: VLD1/VST1 with Vd=15 are 0xF420F7xx/0xF400F7xx, bits22-20 are 010/000):
    F4: (insn & 0xFF70F000u) == 0xF450F000u  -> arm_mem   /* PLI immediate */
        else -> neon_ldst (unchanged)
    F5: (insn & 0xFF70F000u) == 0xF550F000u  -> arm_mem   /* PLD immediate */
        (insn & 0xFF70F000u) == 0xF510F000u  -> arm_mem   /* PLDW immediate */
        (insn & 0xFFFFFFF0u) == 0xF57FF000u  -> arm_misc  /* CLREX/DMB/DSB/ISB */
        else -> arm_misc
    F6/F7:
        (insn & 0xFF70F010u) == 0xF650F000u  -> arm_mem   /* PLI register */
        (insn & 0xFF70F010u) == 0xF750F000u  -> arm_mem   /* PLD register */
        (insn & 0xFF70F010u) == 0xF710F000u  -> arm_mem   /* PLDW register */
        else -> arm_misc
Failing examples today: pldw [r1] = 0xF591F000 -> arm_misc; pld [r1,-r2] = 0xF751F002 -> arm_misc; pli [r1,-r2] = 0xF651F002 -> arm_misc; pld [r1,#-4] = 0xF551F004 -> arm_misc; pli [r1,#-4] = 0xF451F004 -> neon_ldst.

5) Stop codes: I see n2a32_run already does `if (c->stop == N2A32_STOP_NONE) c->stop = N2A32_STOP_UNDEF;`. That is exactly what SVC/BKPT/UDF need (V14 too). No change needed, thanks.

I have host tests covering each failing word (gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v12, N2TEST V12 PASS 200743/200743) but the class functions cannot fix a misrouted word. Please post when the corrected a32_route is in; I will re-run my encodings through your core via a small integration check.
